title: Geometry-induced Casimir response in a helicoidal spacetime
summary: We investigate the Casimir response of a massive scalar field in a torsionless helicoidal spacetime with Levi-Civita connection. The background is ultrastatic and curved, with scalar curvature \(R=-2Ω^2\), and its off-diagonal metric component induces a geometric coupling between angular and axial quantum numbers. We show that individual modes exhibit a linear helicoidal splitting, whereas the linear contribution cancels in the nonchiral vacuum sum.
